basic_info.description: Limited-time opportunity! This charming Noe Valley condo is available to tour 9/6 - 9/12 during the private showing windows below.nPerfectly set on the coveted Sanchez Slow Street, just steps from lively 24th Street, this 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home blends timeless character with modern comforts. Inside, enjoy soaring 11-foot ceilings, elegant crown moldings, a classic fireplace surround, custom built-ins, and gleaming hardwood floors. The spacious kitchen features a farmhouse sink, Caesarstone counters, stainless steel appliances, and generous storage. A full bath with luxurious Heath tile, a guest room with garden views and a private half-bath, plus outdoor space, parking, and in-unit laundry make this home a rare find.
